listing.name: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis — Project-RE-Visited-RE3 (BrazilianHobbyist)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This is experimental RE3 work. Earlier claims of fully static translation and 60 FPS were corrected. An older cache used interpretation for a measured 0.03–0.15% over four sessions totalling 20 minutes. That historical result does not establish no fallback or full-game compatibility. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Resident Evil 3 USA SLUS00923 CUE/BIN with raw 2352-byte sectors. A 2048-byte-sector ISO is rejected because it lacks the required audio and video. This guide does not include the exact accepted hashes; check this game’s project requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: For a source build, follow the project’s build.ps1 -Regen -DiscPath instructions with your own disc, then its launcher build.ps1 instructions. The ZIP launcher also documents InstallGame with your own CUE. Version v1.7 generates its cache from the disc and documents fallback and background toolchain use. This guide does not establish an accepted package.

warnings: This is experimental RE3 work. Earlier claims of fully static translation and 60 FPS were corrected. An older cache used interpretation for a measured 0.03–0.15% over four sessions totalling 20 minutes. That historical result does not establish no fallback or full-game compatibility.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
